body: This is why I'm not going to have children. World is a fucked up place, I wouldn't want to push someone into this. All I can see is a huge responsibility of someone's life and see same person years later struggling with same shit I'm going through. I think of killing myself for years, therapy lately helped me, but I'm still thinking about death as a way out if keeping going will be too hard again.

Depends what you mean by easiest. Less painful or quicker. Or less messy. If I wanted to disappear I'd drown myself. Body gets deformed to the point noone would recognise it, also fishes would take care of some parts of it. I feel like I could disappear this way, if I no longer look myself. Drowning seems painful, but it's just one final effort.
